استخلبن (form X)
# اِسْتَخْلَبْنَ (istaḵlabna) /is.tax.lab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
# اُسْتُخْلِبْنَ (ustuḵlibna) /us.tux.lib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
# اِسْتَخْلِبْنَ (istaḵlibna) /is.tax.lib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
